title: Sam Peck's job offer and the 1930 boat trip to New York
summary: Henderson recalls being hired to play on a street by Sam Peck and the 17-day steamer trip to New York in 1930.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: I was working at that oil station and Sam Peck come down and got me and said, I want to put music on Ja'Kaula Street. You want to come and work? I said, yeah, I'd better be waiting around that and be waiting at the oil station. I don't know if that's when I went there. I don't know if that's when I went there. And you was playing at that other place. Yeah. Well, when was that you all went to New York on the boat? When year was it? 1930. 1930. 1930, I remember. Yeah, 1930. Did that trip take long? I forget. 17-day round trip. It was on a steam at Dixie. Yeah. Did you make several trips? Well, I made one trip in 1930.

blocks.s: Mrs. George Henderson (wife of George Henderson)
blocks.x: They got seasick. They kind of disgust them. They all got their belly.
